churn.basis: Reachable non-merge commit/file touches, current paths only; renames not followed; additions/deletions are path touches, not line counts or defects

duplicateFiles.basis: Exact same nonempty Git blob across source-code paths; tests, fixtures and generated sources included. Byte identity is a candidate for inspection, not semantic equivalence or a defect. Symlinks and empty files excluded.

coverage.basis: Git tracked blobs and Cargo declared path dependencies; not resolved calls or feature activation

forwarding.title: Aggregate runtime forwarding layer removed
forwarding.basis: Pinned source diff and migrated lifecycle callers; no unreachable-code claim
